correctness.rationale: The star/triangle maximal-face classification is exhaustive for pairwise intersecting two-subsets. A maximum-gap map gives an explicit label-equivariant strong retraction of the star union onto a subdivided complete graph; homotopy pushout with the orbit triangles identifies a cyclic quotient of the two-skeleton. Coprimality with six excludes all simplex stabilizers. The quotient has one vertex, m=(n-1)/2 edges, F=(n-1)(n-2)/6 triangles. Distinct triangle orbit relations (0,j,j+1) for j<m eliminate x_2,...,x_m to x_j=t^j; the j=m relator has degree n. Every other triangle relator has exponent multiple n of magnitude <2n, so it can be made null by two-cell slides. The result is M(Z/n,1) wedge F-m spheres. Checks executed from embedded verify.py for n=5,7,11,13,17,19,25,35; these are corroborations only and not infinite proofs.
